column1: # Human-owned, version-controlled. One finding per line, tab-separated:
#   id         the stable finding identity (see findings.json)
#   first_seen the run date the finding was first recorded (free-form, e.g. 2026-07-06)
#   note       optional curator note (e.g. why a finding was dismissed)
# A `dismissed` finding is suppressed from the report. Because identity is keyed on the KB's
# claim (entry + target + check, never line numbers or file paths), editing the claim mints a
# new id and re-surfaces the finding as `new` — a dismissal can never silently silence a
# To adopt the engine's current findings as the baseline, run with --write-baseline (or copy
# build/kb-freshness/baseline.proposed.tsv here) and triage the rows.
# This initial baseline is intentionally empty: on the first run every finding is reported as new.
